evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we introduce Low-Resource Web Agent Benchmark (LoWAgent), a benchmark for evaluating web agents across different low-resource languages (LRLs) in comparison to the default, English.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Web agents are typically evaluated on English-language interfaces, leaving their ability to operate across the world's multilingual websites largely unexplored.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we introduce Low-Resource Web Agent Benchmark (LoWAgent), a benchmark for evaluating web agents across different low-resource languages (LRLs) in comparison to the default, English.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark comprises of six fully localized websites, instantiated across five languages to yield 3,000 task instances.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We further evaluate the robustness of the models on realistic interface disruptions, such as cookie notices and advertisement pop-ups, and find that these further degrade agentic performance.
